name: Pierce County
quote: The Pierce County Board of Education, believing that discipline is an absolute necessity in the classroom of the schools of Pierce County if every child is to receive a quality basic education, does hereby approve the use of corporal punishment in the schools of Pierce County.

name: Floyd County
quote: In recognition of research findings that corporal punishment seldom, if ever, results in positive, long‑term changes in behavior, but more likely leads to increased incidents of aggressive, negative behavior, the Floyd County School System prohibits the use of such punishment as a method of administering a disciplinary consequence.
